title.rendered: Holiday Gift Drive at Middleton December 1st – December 15th

content.rendered:
Middleton is excited to once again partner with the SHARE Center to support local families in need this holiday season. We will collect new, unwrapped gifts and gift cards through December 15.

Donation bins will be located in the Middleton entry hall for easy drop off.

To learn more about the SHARE Center click HERE. If you have any questions, please reach out to the Middleton PAC at board@middletonpac.org.

Thank you in advance for helping us brighten the season for families in our community!
